_comment: Applied by vm/metabase_content.py (D109). The venue filter applies to every card (every_card: each card's SQL has an optional [[AND ... = {{venue}}]]); empty means all venues. Times are relative to the latest day in the data.
name: Venue performance
description: How one venue plays: games per day, the busy hours, what each machine earns, what stands idle, and this week against last. Pick a venue with the filter; empty shows them all.

parameters.name: Venue
parameters.values_sql: SELECT venue_code, venue_code || ' · ' || venue_name FROM annex_api.venues ORDER BY venue_code

cards.name: This week against last
cards.description: Games and estimated revenue in the 7 days up to the latest day in the data, against the 7 days before, per venue.
sql: WITH l AS (SELECT max(day) AS d FROM annex_api.daily_plays),
w AS (
SELECT p.venue_code,
sum(p.games) FILTER (WHERE p.day > l.d - 7) AS games_this,
sum(p.games) FILTER (WHERE p.day <= l.d - 7) AS games_last,
sum(p.revenue_eur) FILTER (WHERE p.day > l.d - 7) AS revenue_this_eur,
sum(p.revenue_eur) FILTER (WHERE p.day <= l.d - 7) AS revenue_last_eur
FROM annex_api.daily_plays p, l
WHERE p.day > l.d - 14 [[AND p.venue_code = {{venue}}]]
GROUP BY p.venue_code)
SELECT venue_code AS venue, games_this AS games_this_week, games_last AS games_week_before,
round(100.0 * (games_this - games_last) / nullif(games_last, 0), 1) AS games_change_pct,
revenue_this_eur AS revenue_this_week_eur, revenue_last_eur AS revenue_week_before_eur,
round(100.0 * (revenue_this_eur - revenue_last_eur) / nullif(revenue_last_eur, 0), 1) AS revenue_change_pct
FROM w ORDER BY venue_code

cards.name: Games per day, 90 days
cards.description: Games played per day and venue over the last 90 days.
sql: WITH l AS (SELECT max(day) AS d FROM annex_api.daily_plays)
SELECT p.day, p.venue_code AS venue, sum(p.games) AS games
FROM annex_api.daily_plays p, l
WHERE p.day > l.d - 90 [[AND p.venue_code = {{venue}}]]
GROUP BY p.day, p.venue_code ORDER BY p.day, p.venue_code

cards.name: Busy hours: games by weekday and hour, 8 weeks
cards.description: Games started per hour of the day (rows) and weekday (columns) over the last 8 weeks; darker is busier. Local time; the day starts at 06:00, so the hours after midnight come last.
sql: WITH l AS (SELECT max(day) AS d FROM annex_api.hourly_plays)
SELECT lpad(h.hour::text, 2, '0') || ':00' AS hour,
sum(h.games) FILTER (WHERE h.weekday = 1) AS mon, sum(h.games) FILTER (WHERE h.weekday = 2) AS tue,
sum(h.games) FILTER (WHERE h.weekday = 3) AS wed, sum(h.games) FILTER (WHERE h.weekday = 4) AS thu,
sum(h.games) FILTER (WHERE h.weekday = 5) AS fri, sum(h.games) FILTER (WHERE h.weekday = 6) AS sat,
sum(h.games) FILTER (WHERE h.weekday = 7) AS sun
FROM annex_api.hourly_plays h, l
WHERE h.day > l.d - 56 [[AND h.venue_code = {{venue}}]]
GROUP BY h.hour ORDER BY (h.hour + 18) % 24

cards.name: Machine earnings, 30 days
cards.description: Every machine on the floor: games and estimated revenue in the last 30 days, per day, and its price. Highest earners first.
sql: WITH l AS (SELECT max(day) AS d FROM annex_api.daily_plays),
p AS (SELECT d.machine_id, sum(d.games) AS games, sum(d.revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur
FROM annex_api.daily_plays d, l WHERE d.day > l.d - 30 GROUP BY d.machine_id)
SELECT f.venue_code AS venue, f.machine_id, f.title, coalesce(f.era, f.machine_type) AS era,
coalesce(p.games, 0) AS games_30_days, coalesce(p.revenue_eur, 0) AS revenue_30_days_eur,
round(coalesce(p.revenue_eur, 0) / 30, 2) AS revenue_per_day_eur, f.price_per_play_eur, f.out_of_order
FROM annex_api.machine_floor f LEFT JOIN p ON p.machine_id = f.machine_id
WHERE true [[AND f.venue_code = {{venue}}]]
ORDER BY revenue_30_days_eur DESC

cards.name: Idle machines: fewest games, last 7 days
cards.description: The 10 machines on the floor with the fewest games in the 7 days up to the latest day in the data: candidates to move, fix or swap.
sql: WITH l AS (SELECT max(day) AS d FROM annex_api.daily_plays),
p AS (SELECT d.machine_id, sum(d.games) AS games, max(d.day) AS last_day
FROM annex_api.daily_plays d, l WHERE d.day > l.d - 30 GROUP BY d.machine_id),
w AS (SELECT d.machine_id, sum(d.games) AS games
FROM annex_api.daily_plays d, l WHERE d.day > l.d - 7 GROUP BY d.machine_id)
SELECT f.venue_code AS venue, f.machine_id, f.title, coalesce(w.games, 0) AS games_7_days,
coalesce(p.games, 0) AS games_30_days, l.d - p.last_day AS days_since_played, f.out_of_order
FROM annex_api.machine_floor f CROSS JOIN l
LEFT JOIN p ON p.machine_id = f.machine_id LEFT JOIN w ON w.machine_id = f.machine_id
WHERE true [[AND f.venue_code = {{venue}}]]
ORDER BY games_7_days, games_30_days
LIMIT 10
